title: Short Drama Weekly Pass vs Coins: Which to Buy
description: Weekly VIP pass or coins for ReelShort, NetShort and other drama apps? How each works, which fits your binge, and how to cancel on iPhone and Android.
h1: Weekly pass or coins? Paying for short dramas without regret
lead: Coins suit one drama you want to finish. A weekly pass suits a binge across several dramas in a few days. A pass renews automatically, so cancel the renewal as soon as you buy.

p: You buy a coin pack and spend coins to unlock episodes one by one. Some coins are free: ReelShort lists daily check-ins, ads and in-app tasks. ReelShort also says free coins can expire, so check your wallet.

links.text: ReelShort: how to earn free coins

p: A weekly pass, often called VIP, unlocks episodes for a week and renews until you cancel. On the US App Store, NetShort lists several Weekly VIP options from $5.99 to $29.99 (checked on the date below). ReelShort's Brazil App Store listing describes its subscription as valid for 7 days and renewing automatically. Prices vary by country, so check your own store.

ul: One drama, a few episodes left: coins.
Several dramas this weekend: weekly pass.
Not hooked yet: neither. Finish the free episodes first.

steps: Open Settings and tap your name.
Tap Cancel Subscription. If there is no cancel button, it is already cancelled.
Open Google Play and go to Subscriptions.
Tap Cancel subscription and follow the steps.
p: Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription. Google says you keep access for the time you already paid for.

faq.q: Is a weekly pass cheaper than coins?
faq.a: For a binge across several dramas, usually yes; for a few episodes of one drama, coins can cost less. Compare both prices in your own app store.

faq.q: How much is a short drama weekly VIP pass?
faq.a: It varies by app and country. On the US App Store, NetShort lists Weekly VIP options from $5.99 to $29.99 (checked October 2026).

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel my subscription?
faq.a: No. Google says uninstalling does not cancel. Cancel in Google Play or in your iPhone's Settings.
ReelShort says free coins sometimes can expire. Check the terms of each bonus in your wallet.
